verdict.rationale: Kit has no documented built-in, in-app AI assistant. What it offers is a remote Kit MCP server that lets external MCP-compatible AI clients read and write account data (subscribers, sequences, broadcasts, tags, segments) on the creator's behalf. Prompts like "draft a broadcast to my new subscribers from this week" become real account actions, but only through a third-party AI tool, which is the extra-tool caveat. Missing for 10: a native AI assistant inside the Kit app, in-product delegation UI, and independent or hands-on corroboration of the MCP delegation flow.
